ios.desc:
A better calendar widget designed for everyone! Used by shift workers, including hospital staff and other healthcare workers.

Free forever.
No ads forever.
No data collected.

Features:
- Syncs with Apple Calendar app
- Select individual or multiple calendars
- Correct handling of night shifts compared to the default app
- Light mode and dark mode styling
- Style variant
- Color matches your calendar

show_hn.title: Show HN: A calendar widget for shift workers

quotes.text:
I'm making small improvements to things that I use daily with the help of AI (mainly using Claude Projects in the browser).

I created a simple Hacker News Redesign extension to make my mobile browsing experience better (larger touch targets, prettier UI and texts). https://apps.apple.com/us/app/y-redesign-for-hacker-news/id6701998952

I made a widget that better shows my work shifts (I work nights and the default calendar app displays overnights as two days in the zoomed out monthly view, so this improves upon that and also counts how many shifts I've completed in a month while looking nice too). https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-next-shift-widget/id6740635687

I wrote a simple MacOS app that lets me drag and drop screenshots then choose between a variety of "device frames" to create a consistent style and speed up my workflow.

And now I'm working on some plug-ins for open source apps that I use. Generally just doing small things to improve my workflow and enjoyment with my hobbies.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (July 2025)

quotes.text: I work in the hospital and wanted a better calendar widget that let me: select only my work calendar, show the time until my next shift, and show how many shifts I have for the month. It's been useful to me, so I wanted to share it with everyone as a free widget on iOS.
